comment: Licks written in A. Notes: [string, fret, beat, length in beats, technique, bend in semitones]. Techniques: h hammer-on, p pull-off, s slide, b bend, r release, v vibrato.

licks.name: Box 1 walk-down
licks.description: Straight down box 1 from the high C to the root on the 4th string. The first lick to get under your fingers: two notes per string, index and ring or pinky.

licks.name: Bend up to the 5th
licks.description: Bend the 4 (D) on the 3rd string a whole step until it sounds like the 5 (E). Use three fingers to push, and check the pitch against the E on the 2nd string, 5th fret.

licks.name: Hammer and pull
licks.description: Pick only the first note on each string and hammer on to the second. Then pull off from D back to C. Legato makes the line flow instead of sounding picked.

licks.name: The blue note
licks.description: Climb from the b3 to the b5 (E-flat, the blue note) and fall back to the root. Do not sit on the b5: it is a passing colour next to the 4 and the 5. Here it is a quick step up from the 4 and straight back.

licks.name: Bend and release
licks.description: Bend the b7 (G) up to the root (A), let it back down to G without picking again, then walk down to the root.

licks.name: Low-string riff
licks.description: A bass-register phrase up through the blues scale from the low root, with the blue note on the 5th string. Good as a riff to repeat over the I chord.

licks.name: Major pentatonic sweetness
licks.description: The same pattern as box 1, three frets lower, is A major pentatonic: brighter and sweeter. Use it over the I chord, and go back to minor for the IV and V.

licks.name: Half-step bend to the major 3rd
licks.description: Bend the b3 (C) a half step to C-sharp, the 3rd of the A7 chord. Major and minor at once: the essential blues sound.

licks.name: Triplet cascade
licks.description: Box 1 down in triplets for a slow 12/8 blues. Keep every note the same length and land on the root right on beat 3.

licks.name: Box 2 climb
licks.description: Up through box 2 and a whole-step bend from the 4 (D) to the 5 (E) on the top string. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends.

licks.name: Slide up to the 5th
licks.description: Slide from the b3 to the 5 on the 3rd string to move from box 1 into box 2, then finish on the b3 up top.

licks.name: Turnaround walk-down
licks.description: Bars 11 and 12 lead back to the top of the form. This one walks down chromatically from the root to the 5, ready for the V chord.

licks.name: Call and answer
licks.description: Two bars: a call (repeated bends up high) and an answer that walks down to the low root. Play the call, leave space, answer. This is how blues phrases talk.
